title: Cisco UCS
description: Cisco UCS Manager domains monitored by ucs-exporter.

panels.title: Domains up
panels.description: 0 if any selected domain's latest poll failed.

panels.title: VIFs down
panels.description: Virtual circuits (vNIC/vHBA paths) whose link is not up.

panels.title: FC ports down
panels.description: FC ports that are not up, excluding empty SFP cages.

panels.title: Components not operable
panels.description: Every component whose operability is not 'operable'.

panels.title: VLAN port usage
panels.description: VLAN port instances in use as a fraction of the platform limit.

panels.title: FI port discards and pause frames
Ports and port channel members down
FC link failures, signal and sync losses (per hour)
FC ports, SAN port channels and FCoE uplinks not up
Service profiles, vNICs and virtual circuits
Virtual circuits down
panels.description: VIFs (one per vNIC/vHBA per fabric) whose operational state is not active.

panels.title: Virtual circuit pinning
panels.description: The FI uplink port or port channel each virtual circuit is pinned to.

panels.title: IOM host ports down (with connected adapter)

targets.expr: (ucs_iom_host_port_up{domain=~"$domain",chassis=~"$chassis"} == 0) * on (domain, chassis, iom, port) group_left(server, adaptor, interface) ucs_iom_host_port_peer_info

panels.title: IOM fabric port CRC errors (per hour)
Correctable ECC errors (top 10 DIMMs, per hour)

targets.expr: (ucs_server_dimm_ecc_multibit_errors_total{domain=~"$domain"} > 0) * on (domain, server, memory_array, dimm) group_left(location) ucs_server_dimm_info
